summary.title_hr: PODCAST MREŽNICA - Polović: Velika igra velike trojke: Dijele svijet! Iran čekaju napadi
summary.abstract_hr: U ovoj epizodi Podcasta Mrežnica geopolitička analitičarka i politologinja Jadranka Polović analizira aktualno globalno stanje: američke midterm izbore, rat s Iranom, izbore u Izraelu, rat u Ukrajini i mogući sastanak Trumpa, Putina i Šija o podjeli sfera utjecaja. Gošća smatra da svijet prelazi iz unipolarnog poretka u razdoblje bez globalnog vodstva, u kojem se SAD ponaša kao slon u staklani i u kojem treba očekivati nove ratove i sukobe. Kritizira Europu zbog odbijanja diplomacije prema Rusiji i zalaže se za mirno rješenje rata u Ukrajini. Prosvjede u Europi tumači kao posljedicu socioekonomske nejednakosti i otpora remilitarizaciji te poziva na radikalan zaokret od neoliberalnih politika. Razgovor završava osvrtom na ulogu Hrvatske i izraženom zabrinutošću za budućnost Europe.

key_points: Gošća smatra da su ljudi, osobito mladi, postali izrazito politizirani zbog velikih geopolitičkih izazova na koje vlade nisu dale dobre odgovore, pa se gotovo svaki izbori pretvaraju u referendum.

Očekuje da će Trump na midterm izborima izgubiti Zastupnički dom, a za Senat ishod smatra neizvjesnim. Prema njezinu mišljenju, rat u Iranu učinio ga je gubitnikom jer američka administracija nije ostvarila nikakve ciljeve, no ipak očekuje nekoliko velikih novih napada na Iran.
Smatra da izbori u Izraelu neće donijeti promjenu politike prema Gazi i Iranu, jer i oporbeni blok protiv Netanyahua ima svoje jastrebove.
Mogući sastanak Trumpa, Putina i Šija vidi kao priliku za podjelu sfera interesa i utjecaja. Svijet, prema njezinim riječima, ulazi u razdoblje bez globalnog vodstva, s mnogo novih ratova i sukoba.

Rat u Ukrajini treba završiti diplomacijom, pri čemu Ukrajina treba biti neutralna država izvan NATO-a. Kritizira Europu što je od početka bojkotirala diplomaciju i zalaže se za povratak konceptu nedjeljive europske sigurnosti.

Prosvjede u Europi tumači kao izraz socioekonomskog nezadovoljstva, globalne nejednakosti (10% ljudi raspolaže sa 75% svjetskog bogatstva) i otpora remilitarizaciji. Zalaže se za radikalni zaokret od neoliberalnih politika i spominje Pikettyjev prijedlog globalnog poreza na bogatstvo.

Za Hrvatsku ističe problem odnosa predsjednika i premijera, zbog kojeg veleposlanici nisu imenovani ni u važnim državama. Smatra da bi se Hrvatska trebala diplomatski angažirati u zaustavljanju rata te poticati ulazak Srbije i Crne Gore u Europsku uniju.

key_topics_en: geopolitics and the new world order
US midterm elections and donald trump's politics
war with iran and israeli elections
war in ukraine and european diplomacy
meeting of trump, putin, and xi and spheres of influence
protests in europe and global inequality
serbia, western balkans, and croatian foreign policy
key_points_en: The guest believes that people, especially youth, have become extremely politicized due to major geopolitical challenges to which governments have not provided good answers, so almost every election turns into a referendum.

She expects that Trump will lose the House of Representatives in the midterm elections, while considering the outcome for the Senate uncertain. In her opinion, the war in Iran made him a loser because the US administration did not achieve any goals, but she nevertheless expects several major new attacks on Iran.
She considers that the elections in Israel will not bring a change of policy toward Gaza and Iran, because the opposition bloc against Netanyahu also has its hawks.

She sees a possible meeting between Trump, Putin, and Xi as an opportunity to divide spheres of interest and influence. The world, according to her words, is entering a period without global leadership, with many new wars and conflicts.

The war in Ukraine should end with diplomacy, with Ukraine needing to be a neutral state outside NATO. She criticizes Europe for boycotting diplomacy from the beginning and advocates for a return to the concept of indivisible European security.

She interprets the protests in Europe as an expression of socioeconomic dissatisfaction, global inequality (10% of people possess 75% of world wealth), and resistance to remilitarization. She advocates for a radical departure from neoliberal policies and mentions Piketty's proposal of a global wealth tax.

For Croatia, she highlights the problem of relations between the president and the prime minister, due to which ambassadors have not been appointed even in important countries. She believes that Croatia should engage diplomatically in stopping the war and encourage the accession of Serbia and Montenegro to the European Union.

summary.title_en: PODCAST MREŽNICA - Polović: The Big Game of the Big Three: They are Dividing the World! Attacks Await Iran
summary.abstract_en: In this episode of Podcast Mrežnica, geopolitical analyst and political scientist Jadranka Polović analyzes the current global situation: the US midterm elections, the war with Iran, the elections in Israel, the war in Ukraine, and a possible meeting between Trump, Putin, and Xi on dividing spheres of influence. The guest believes that the world is transitioning from a unipolar order into a period without global leadership, in which the US behaves like a bull in a china shop and in which new wars and conflicts should be expected. She criticizes Europe for rejecting diplomacy toward Russia and advocates for a peaceful resolution of the war in Ukraine. She interprets the protests in Europe as a consequence of socioeconomic inequality and resistance to remilitarization, and calls for a radical departure from neoliberal policies. The conversation concludes with an overview of Croatia's role and an expressed concern for the future of Europe.
